Alternopedia:About: **Alternopedia** is a free online encyclopedia of a timeline that is not yours. It looks like an ordinary encyclopedia, it is written like an ordinary encyclopedia, and almost everything in it happened slightly differently.

Every article starts from something real (a phone, a tower, a war against birds) and follows it down a path that history did not take. The tone is deadpan on purpose: the joke works best when the encyclopedia believes every word.

No. **Alternopedia is a parody and every article is fiction.** People, references and quotations in articles are invented unless they describe well-known history before the point where the timelines split. Alternopedia is not affiliated with Wikipedia or the Wikimedia Foundation.
- [[Special:WantedPages|Wanted pages]]: topics already linked from articles but not yet written
Alternopedia:Contents: Alternopedia's articles are organised into a single large portal, because there are not many of them yet.
See also [[Special:AllPages|all pages]] and the list of [[Special:WantedPages|wanted pages]].
Alternopedia:General disclaimer: **Alternopedia makes no guarantee of validity**, in this or any other timeline.

Alternopedia is a work of humorous fiction. Its articles imitate the style of an encyclopedia but describe an alternate reality. Do not cite Alternopedia in school work, court, or arguments at family dinners, unless the family dinner is taking place during the [[25th Hour]].
Names of real companies, places and products appear only as part of obvious satire. Alternopedia is not affiliated with Wikipedia, the Wikimedia Foundation, or any company mentioned in its articles.
Alternopedia:Contact us: The Elsewhen Foundation can be reached by carrier emu at the Office of the Emu Commissioner, Merredin, Western Australia. Allow six to eight weeks, or one migration season.
Questions about the site itself are best raised with whoever sent you the link.
Alternopedia:Community portal: Welcome to the **Community portal**, the place to find things to do on Alternopedia.
- Write one of the [[Special:WantedPages|wanted pages]]: every red link is an article waiting to happen.
- Add [[Alternopedia:Citation needed|citations]] from sources that exist only in this timeline.
- Help the [[Tower of Pisa#Progetto Ripiego|Progetto Ripiego]] by leaning slightly to the left.
Alternopedia:Village pump: The **Village pump** is used to discuss the technical issues, policies and operations of Alternopedia.
- *Should the Main Page acknowledge the other timeline?* (closed: no consensus, partly because nobody remembers it the same way)
- *Is the Iceberg a proper noun?* (archived after 4,100 comments)
Alternopedia:News: - **October 2026**: The [[25th Hour]] lasts 61 minutes; editors use the extra minute to fix typos.
- **2026**: Alternopedia opens to visitors from other timelines (read-only).
Alternopedia:Teahouse: Welcome to the **Teahouse**, a friendly place to ask questions about Alternopedia.
**Q:** Why does everything here seem familiar but wrong?
**A:** You are from the other timeline. It happens to most of our readers. Have some tea.
Alternopedia:Help desk: The **Help desk** answers questions about using Alternopedia.
**Q:** How do I edit a page?
**A:** Visitors from other timelines can view the source of any page (use *Edit* at the top), but cannot save changes.
Alternopedia:Reference desk: The **Reference desk** answers research questions on any topic, in either timeline.
**Q:** Did the iPhone come out in 2007?
**A:** It was announced in 2007. See [[iPhone (cancelled project)]], and in particular the section on the Mandela effect.
Alternopedia:Privacy policy: Alternopedia does not collect personal information. Your appearance settings (text size, width and colour) are stored only in your own browser.
The site is a static collection of pages. It sets no tracking cookies in any timeline.
Alternopedia:Cookie statement: Alternopedia stores your appearance preferences in your browser's local storage. It does not use advertising or tracking cookies.
The only cookies on the site are referred to in [[Wawel Dragon|the Kraków heating ledgers]], and they were eaten in 1190.
Alternopedia:Copyrights: The text of Alternopedia is original humorous fiction. Illustrations were drawn specifically for Alternopedia and are not photographs of anything real.
Alternopedia's look is inspired by the MediaWiki *Vector* skin used by many wikis. Alternopedia is not affiliated with Wikipedia or the Wikimedia Foundation.
Alternopedia:Terms of Use: By reading Alternopedia you agree not to present its articles as fact in your own timeline. Screenshots are welcome; please leave the name visible so nobody mistakes them for the real thing.
Alternopedia:Code of Conduct: Be kind to editors, readers and icebergs.
Alternopedia:Featured articles: **Featured articles** are considered to be the best articles Alternopedia has to offer. They are marked with a small star at the top right of the page.
Alternopedia:Good articles: **Good articles** meet a core set of editorial standards, though they may not be featured-quality yet.
Alternopedia:Protection policy: Some articles are **semi-protected** because they are frequently edited by readers from other timelines who are certain they are right. The [[Tower of Pisa]] is the best-known example.
Alternopedia:Did you know: **Did you know** is the section of the Main Page that features new or recently expanded articles. To be eligible, a fact must be interesting, sourced and untrue in your timeline.
Alternopedia:Citation needed: The tag *[citation needed]* marks a claim whose only known source is in another timeline. Such claims should not be removed; they should be believed cautiously.
Alternopedia:File upload wizard: Uploading files and creating new articles are not available to visitors from other timelines.
If you have an idea for an article, the [[Special:WantedPages|wanted pages]] list shows topics that are already linked but not yet written.
Alternopedia:Selected anniversaries: **Selected anniversaries** appear in the *On this day* section of the Main Page. Because the history of this timeline is still being written, anniversaries are currently rotated daily rather than tied to dates.
Alternopedia:Featured pictures: **Featured pictures** are images that add significantly to an article and are of high quality. All of them were drawn for Alternopedia.
Portal:Current events: - The European Union observes the [[25th Hour]], which lasts 61 minutes this year.
- The [[Reclassification of Earth|fifth appeal]] on Earth's planetary status is rejected.
- The [[Tower of Pisa]] reaches a tilt of 0.21 degrees.
- The Oulu Phone Spire opens; see [[Nokia 3310]].
Help:Contents: - Use the search box at the top of every page to find articles. Press Enter on an exact title to go straight to it.
- **Red links** lead to articles that have not been written yet in this timeline.
- *View history* shows who has argued about a page; *Edit* shows its source.
- The *Appearance* menu changes text size, page width and colour (including a dark mode).
- On a phone, the *Desktop view* link at the bottom of each page shows the full desktop layout.
Help:Introduction: Alternopedia articles are written by editors of this timeline. Visitors from other timelines can read every page and view its source, but cannot save edits.
See [[Help:Contents]] for tips on reading the site.
Help:Category: **Categories** group related articles. They are listed in a box at the bottom of each article; click one to see every article in it.
